reasoning: On the season so far the Thunder are the stronger team; with home court the Thunder start about 13 points better, in a game of about 229 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 0 points towards the Thunder.
The mental side leans about 0 points towards the Thunder.
Bottom line: the Thunder win 87 times in 100, by about 14; most games like this end between 204 and 253 total points.
